card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (0, 2, 3, 4) that sits in the middle of a number of three or more digits, right after the first two digits. It shows up in counts of ships, troops, patients, lots and areas, and in dose amounts.

modes.label: Counts in history and news
modes.description: Third digit of a large count of people, ships or units in narrative text.
modes.example: He collected a large force of mercenaries, and a fleet of 30<<0>> ships.
